title: spec: export the sub-schemas the Console reads, so its first load stops pulling whole ActionSchema, FieldSchema and ListViewSchema graphs
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (named next step of a measured perf card) · Source: fleet (PR #37786 hand-off, card #37572; readings on #37444 comment 7209516099)

## What happens

PR #37786 cut 97,612 gzipped bytes from the Console's first load by marking spec's module-scope initializers droppable. After it, the largest remaining spec cost on the first load comes from schemas like `ActionSchema`, `FieldSchema` and `ListViewSchema`. At each of these sites the Console uses only one sub-schema, but because only the whole schema is exported, the whole graph is kept. The first load is still over the 2500 ms target on the list page (2652) and the record page (2640). Acceptance is HTTPS + HTTP/2, per ruling 7205984444.

## Expected

- `@objectstack/spec` exports the sub-schemas the Console actually reads, as new named exports. This is a public API addition: `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.
- The Console and the ui packages import those, and the eager closure budget is re-pinned.
- Readings go on #37444 as before (10 runs each, h2 medians, list/record/home).

Reader: the ux lane thread on #37444 / #37572.
Grade: area:ux · Feature · reach: measured (eager closure readings on PR #37786) → p2, since it follows the open p2 first-screen card.
